entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. This call may be recorded for quality assurance. How may I assist you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's just not working out for me.
Certainly! I can help with that. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's [customer email address]. And hurry up, I don’t have all day.
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse. Can you confirm the date of purchase?
I bought it on the 1st. Today is the 16th, so…
I understand. Looking at our return policy, the return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of purchase. Unfortunately, it appears you are outside of that window.
What?! That's ridiculous! I’ve barely had it. I want a refund. This thing is junk!

I understand your frustration. I am truly sorry, but because you are past the return window, a full refund isn't possible. However, I can offer you store credit for the current value of the VeloBand Pulse. This credit can be used towards any other VeloFit product. Would that be acceptable?
Store credit? I wanted my money back! This is unbelievable. I need to speak to a manager.

I understand your disappointment. Let me see if there's a policy exception I can request for you. One moment, please... Okay, I've reviewed your account, and while I still cannot process a full refund due to the return window expiration, I can offer an additional 10% off your next VeloFit purchase on top of the store credit, as a one-time exception.
So, store credit plus 10% off my next purchase? Okay, I guess that's… better than nothing. How do I get the store credit?

Great! I'm glad we could find a solution. I've already applied the store credit to your account associated with [customer email address]. You'll also receive an email with the details and the 10% off coupon code. You can use it anytime on our website for anything from apparel to new equipment. You will see the store credit reflected in your account on the VeloFit website.
Okay, I see the email. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for contacting VeloFit! Have a great day!
